title: Recital rehearsal: peer checking Al-Haqqah: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Haqqah; noon and meem recap and when letters meet
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 23 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Recital rehearsal rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 23. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Check conditions
points: Steady pace, stop only at ayah ends

keywords.def: revision of what is already memorised
the checklist used to assess recitation

questions.q: Give precise feedback on this: a pupil says «مِنْ أُوتِىَ» in 69:19 instead of «مَنْ أُوتِىَ».
questions.a: 69:19, مَنْ: the vowel is fathah (man), not kasrah (min); it changes the word from 'whoever' to 'from'.

questions.q: Rehearsal in breakout pairs: each recites half of Al-Haqqah under check conditions and receives one precise target (pupil PDF). Today's rota group recites to the teacher.
questions.a: Each pupil has one written target and a second attempt.

questions.q: Extend: recite 69:1 to 52 to a parent tonight.
Stretch: lead a group of three, giving each a target.

options: 69:7, حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى: ikhfa, not a clear noon
questions.a: A) 69:7, حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى: ikhfa, not a clear noon. Precise feedback names the ayah, word and rule so it can be fixed.

questions.q: Think again: Athletes rehearse before a race. What does a good rehearsal for a recitation check look like?
questions.a: Recite under check conditions, get one precise target, fix it, recite again.
